_comment: Coordinator-only P-3 clean-room protocol template. This is not a comparison contract, Decision J, clean-room evidence, gate manifest, or role attachment. It never becomes a P-3 runtime input.
lifecycleOrder: baseline pair-readiness pre-begin while both actual worktrees are unimplemented
baseline pair-begin while both actual worktrees are unimplemented
baseline pair-preflight while both actual worktrees are unimplemented
current pair-preflight while both actual worktrees are unimplemented
only after both pair-preflight commands PASS: deliver role packets and begin condition implementation loops
run baseline and current loops sequentially
pair-readiness pre-close, pair-close, report, and compare only after the fixed loops complete

coordinatorChecks: coordinator-only progress ledger expected component / attempt / deliverySequence
attemptOneCreatePaths exactly match the component return plan
derivedBootstrapDirectories exactly match the directories derived from attemptOneCreatePaths
attemptOneCreatePaths partition frozen changeTargets exactly once across the checkpoint plan
P-3 hero-laurel ownership: sequence 3 only; sequence 6 may not create or change it
progressOrder: one actual matching figma-gate checkpoint result in the actual worktree active state
one same-condition feedback artifact and p3-role-return --record-feedback
only then the next component or retry delivery
implementationLoop.comparisonInterpretation: A/B difference under this identical protocol only
negativeTestRequirements: N-1: Creating a target outside this sequence's allowedChangeTargets fails.
N-2: Any new target creation at attempt 2 or later fails.
N-3: A target already created by one sequence cannot be created again by another sequence.
N-4: A target cannot be created twice within one sequence.
N-5: A bootstrap directory outside site/, absolute, traversal-bearing, or under a forbidden root fails.
N-6: protocol componentReturnScopes and return-plan allowedChangeTargets, attemptOneCreatePaths, or derivedBootstrapDirectories mismatch fails.
N-7: The union of all attemptOneCreatePaths is not an exact 28-target partition of frozen changeTargets fails.
N-8: Recovery finds a non-empty transaction-created directory, preserves it, reports it, and fails closed.
N-9: Recovery never deletes a directory absent from its journal.

N-10: A crash after mkdir and before the created-state write recovers an empty journal-intent-proven directory to a consistent rollback state; a non-empty or journal-unproven directory remains fail-closed.
N-11: A v1 journal recovers successfully through v2 code.
N-12: A v2 journal with a required field missing fails.
N-13: A condition-local return authority whose packet manifest, attachment hash, or identityLeakScan does not match fails.
N-14: sequence 6 attempts to create or change site/assets/hero/hero-laurel.png and fails.
N-15: baseline and current finalized handoff-protocol bytes differ and fail.
N-16: a registry or return plan without per-condition delivery progress, or whose first delivery sequence is not 1 for each condition, fails.
retainedLegacyV4NegativeTests: A legacy firstComponentFullCreate field is rejected; it is a negative-test fixture only and is not a v2 runtime field.
A create path outside its component allowlist is rejected.
A shared delimiter-region return with any byte changed outside its declared delimiters is rejected.

returnPackage.pairPreflightAuthority: absolute actual common-Git ledger plus baseline/current actual-worktree v13 contract, frozen gate manifest, v5 active preflight state with condition implementationIdentity/responsive input bindings, and preflightId bindings
returnPackage.progressLedger: coordinator-only hash-chained JSONL; applies write an intent before worktree mutation and an applied record only after the recovery journal completes
returnPackage.checkpointProof: --record-checkpoint reads the actual .figma-gate/active.json and one newly appended matching benchmark attempt; PASS additionally binds the actual checkpoint evidence files
returnPackage.sameConditionFeedback: --record-feedback requires an opaque-handoff-bound artifact whose outcome and failure class equal the coordinator checkpoint proof
returnPackage.nextDeliveryGuard: the progress ledger rejects a second apply before checkpoint/feedback, skipped attempts, wrong checkpoint order, reused handoff IDs, and replay after completion
returnPackage.interruptedApplyCaveat: after an interrupted apply, --recover may restore files but cannot silently advance or clear the progress intent; later returns remain fail-closed pending separate coordinator review

attachmentOnlyEvidence.ownerOperationalBoundary: All role attachments are enumerated, hash-bound, and packet-checked by the coordinator. This records an owner-operated procedural boundary and does not claim filesystem denial or technical isolation.
